page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 24 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The processor is equipped with a 35 MB L3 cache and supports instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX512F, AES, and FMA. The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside a poor rating in single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 24 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, achieving middle-tier results in stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression tests. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average tier, with read-only large block speeds reaching 90.83 GB/sec.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated core allocation, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for parallelized workloads that do not require high single-thread performance or massive memory footprints. It is well-suited for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations, where it achieves average throughput. It can also handle basic machine learning tasks, such as text generation with medium-sized (7B) language models, but is less optimal for memory-intensive databases or single-threaded processing pipelines.
